newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-NYMEX crude in range, support at $19.40-50.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-NYMEX crude in range, support at $19.40-50.

text.p: NYMEX crude oil futures are expected to remain bound within Tuesday's range between $19.48 and $19.84, traders and technical analysts said on Wednesday.
June NYMEX crude closed three cents up on Tuesday at $19.66 a barrel, roughly in the middle of the day's range.
June heating oil ended 0.48 cent higher at 53.53 cents per gallon, while June gasoline closed 0.23 cents off at 60.31 cents.
A trader in New York said he was looking to trade the range explored by the June contract on Tuesday.
"The technical numbers are falling within yesterday's range," he said. "We have got resistance up at $19.84, yesterday's high, while I expect some support at $19.48, then $19.30," he said.
Chartists also see support at $19.44, the low point reached on May 2, followed by stronger support at around $19.40, based on lows from last month.
MeesPierson Derivatives in London, employing their Market Profile technique, said they saw $19.88 as an important overhead selling level.
"We look to try this level again, waiting for $19.48/40 or range lows of $19.10 to take profits and buy, waiting for a retest of the top of the range."
They pegged the range for June heating oil at 53.00 to 53.90 cents a gallon, while gasoline would find overhead obstacles at 61.20 and 61.90 cents.
